svg.aria-label: The hidden terminal problem in Wi-Fi: stations A and C can both hear the access point but not each other, so carrier sensing fails and their frames collide at the access point. RTS/CTS lets the access point reserve the channel; CSMA/CA uses random backoff and link-layer ACKs.
svg.title: The hidden terminal problem in Wi-Fi: stations A and C can both hear the access point but not each other, so carrier sensing fails and their frames collide at the access point. RTS/CTS lets the access point reserve the channel; CSMA/CA uses random backoff and link-layer ACKs.
svg.text: A and C can't hear each other (distance, walls)
Fix: RTS → CTS ("C, stay quiet for 2 ms") · random backoff · ACK every frame
